properties.property: SSTORE operation MUST check that gasleft > 2300 before proceeding
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore_op: SSTORE_OPERATION. pre(sstore_op) => gasleft(sstore_op) > 2300
properties.rationale: The 2300 gas stipend check is a critical security boundary that prevents reentrancy attacks via CALL/SEND operations. If gasleft <= 2300, SSTORE must throw OOG exception.

properties.property: A call with only 2300 gas stipend MUST NOT be able to modify storage
properties.formal_spec: forall call_frame: CALL_FRAME. gasleft(call_frame) <= 2300 => ¬can_modify_storage(call_frame)
properties.rationale: This invariant ensures that legacy contracts using transfer() or send() with 2300 gas stipend remain protected against reentrancy attacks that attempt state modification.

properties.property: SSTORE with current == new MUST charge only SLOAD_GAS (800)
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. current_value(sstore) == new_value(sstore) => gas_charged(sstore) == 800
properties.rationale: No-op storage operations should not charge full SSTORE cost as no actual state change occurs.

properties.property: First modification of zero-valued slot MUST charge SSTORE_SET_GAS (20000)
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. is_clean(sstore) && original_value(sstore) == 0 && new_value(sstore) != 0 => gas_charged(sstore) == 20000
properties.rationale: Setting a new non-zero value in a previously empty slot requires creating new state trie nodes, justifying the highest gas cost.

properties.property: First modification of non-zero-valued slot MUST charge SSTORE_RESET_GAS (5000)
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. is_clean(sstore) && original_value(sstore) != 0 && new_value(sstore) != current_value(sstore) => gas_charged(sstore) == 5000
properties.rationale: Modifying an existing non-zero slot is cheaper than creating new state as no new trie nodes are needed.

properties.property: Subsequent modifications to already-modified slot MUST charge only SLOAD_GAS (800)
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. is_dirty(sstore) => gas_charged(sstore) == 800
properties.rationale: Once a slot is 'dirty' (already modified in transaction), additional modifications are cheap since the original value is cached.

properties.property: Clearing a clean non-zero slot to zero MUST add SSTORE_CLEARS_SCHEDULE (15000) refund
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. is_clean(sstore) && original_value(sstore) != 0 && new_value(sstore) == 0 => refund_added(sstore) == 15000
properties.rationale: Clearing storage slots reduces state size; refunds incentivize state cleanup while net metering prevents refund gaming.

properties.property: Restoring a dirty slot to original value MUST add appropriate refund
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. is_dirty(sstore) && new_value(sstore) == original_value(sstore) => refund_added(sstore) > 0
properties.rationale: Restoring original value essentially undoes the transaction's storage changes, deserving partial refund of initial modification cost.

properties.property: Un-zeroing a slot that was previously zeroed in transaction MUST remove the clear refund
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. is_dirty(sstore) && current_value(sstore) == 0 && new_value(sstore) != 0 => refund_removed(sstore) == 15000
properties.rationale: This prevents refund gaming where a contract clears storage (getting refund) then restores non-zero value.

properties.property: Original value MUST be immutable throughout transaction execution
properties.formal_spec: forall tx: TRANSACTION, slot: STORAGE_SLOT. original_value(slot, tx_start) == original_value(slot, tx_end)
properties.rationale: Net gas metering depends on reliably tracking the pre-transaction value. If original values could change, gas calculations would be incorrect.

properties.property: Storage slot state transitions MUST follow valid state machine paths
properties.formal_spec: forall slot: STORAGE_SLOT. valid_transition(slot.previous_state, slot.current_state)
properties.rationale: Only specific state transitions are allowed: untouched->zeroed, untouched->modified, zeroed->modified, modified->zeroed, modified->restored.

properties.property: Gas stipend boundary check MUST use <= operator (gasleft <= 2300 triggers OOG)
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. gasleft(sstore) <= 2300 => throws_oog(sstore)
properties.rationale: Resolves AMB-EIP2200-01 ambiguity about the exact boundary condition for reentrancy protection.

properties.property: Reentrancy protection effectiveness depends on compilers maintaining 2300 gas stipend convention
properties.formal_spec: forall compiler: COMPILER, transfer_call: TRANSFER. gas_stipend(transfer_call) == 2300
properties.rationale: If compilers change the stipend value, the reentrancy guard boundary may not align with expected behavior.

properties.property: Post-Constantinople, fake_block_number MUST equal max(0, block.number - 5000000)
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.number >= CNSTNTNPL_FORK_BLKNUM => fake_block_number(block) == max(0, block.number - 5000000)
properties.rationale: The 5 million block offset delays the difficulty bomb by approximately 12 months, giving time for Ethereum 2.0 development.

properties.property: Difficulty bomb delay MUST only activate at or after CNSTNTNPL_FORK_BLKNUM
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. applies_bomb_delay(block) <=> block.number >= CNSTNTNPL_FORK_BLKNUM
properties.rationale: Fork activation must be deterministic based on block number to ensure network consensus.

properties.property: Pre-fork blocks MUST use actual block number for difficulty calculation
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.number < CNSTNTNPL_FORK_BLKNUM => difficulty_block_number(block) == block.number
properties.rationale: Pre-fork rules must remain unchanged to maintain backward compatibility and ensure valid chain history.

properties.property: Post-Constantinople base block reward MUST be exactly 2 ETH
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.number >= CNSTNTNPL_FORK_BLKNUM => base_reward(block) == 2000000000000000000
properties.rationale: Reward reduction from 3 ETH to 2 ETH reduces issuance rate by ~33%, part of Ethereum's monetary policy.

properties.property: Nephew reward per uncle MUST be base_reward / 32
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK, uncle: UNCLE. nephew_reward(uncle) == base_reward(block) / 32
properties.rationale: Nephew reward incentivizes miners to include uncle blocks, maintaining the reduced reward proportions post-Constantinople.

properties.property: Uncle reward MUST equal ((8-k) * base_reward) / 8 where k = block.number - uncle.number
properties.formal_spec: forall uncle: UNCLE, block: BLOCK. uncle_reward(uncle) == ((8 - (block.number - uncle.number)) * base_reward(block)) / 8
properties.rationale: Uncle reward formula ensures closer uncles receive more reward, incentivizing timely block propagation.

properties.property: Block difficulty MUST match expected calculation based on applicable rules
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. is_valid(block) => block.difficulty == expected_difficulty(block)
properties.rationale: Consensus requires all nodes to compute identical expected difficulty for validation.

properties.property: Block with incorrect difficulty MUST be rejected
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.difficulty != expected_difficulty(block) => is_rejected(block)
properties.rationale: Difficulty mismatch indicates invalid block production or protocol violation.

properties.property: Block with incorrect reward application MUST be rejected
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. coinbase_credit(block) != expected_rewards(block) => is_rejected(block)
properties.rationale: Incorrect rewards could inflate supply or underpay miners, breaking economic incentives.

properties.property: Network security depends on 2 ETH reward providing sufficient mining incentive
properties.formal_spec: mining_incentive(2_ETH) >= minimum_security_threshold
properties.rationale: If reward becomes insufficient relative to mining costs, hashrate drop could enable 51% attacks.

properties.property: Post-Arrow Glacier, fake_block_number MUST equal max(0, block.number - 10700000)
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.number >= FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER => fake_block_number(block) == max(0, block.number - 10700000)
properties.rationale: The 10.7 million block offset provides approximately 7.5 months additional delay for the difficulty bomb.

properties.property: Fork status check MUST compare block number against FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. fork_check(block) == (block.number >= FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER)
properties.rationale: Deterministic fork activation is essential for maintaining network consensus across all clients.

properties.property: Block difficulty MUST match expected value computed with correct offset
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. is_valid(block) => block.difficulty == compute_expected_difficulty(block, fake_block_number(block))
properties.rationale: All nodes must agree on difficulty calculation to maintain consensus.

properties.property: Block with difficulty mismatch MUST be rejected
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.difficulty != expected_difficulty(block) => is_rejected(block)
properties.rationale: Rejecting invalid difficulty blocks is essential for consensus security.

properties.property: Network MUST transition from pre-Arrow Glacier to post-Arrow Glacier state exactly once
properties.formal_spec: exists! block: BLOCK. block.number == FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER && triggers_fork_activation(block)
properties.rationale: Fork transition is a one-time irreversible event that must occur exactly at the specified block number.

properties.property: Post-fork, all difficulty calculations MUST apply the 10.7M block offset
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. block.number > FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER => uses_offset(difficulty_calc(block), 10700000)
properties.rationale: Consistent offset application across all post-fork blocks ensures uniform difficulty bomb delay.

properties.property: Difficulty bomb delay timing assumes stable network hashrate
properties.formal_spec: delay_timing_accurate <=> hashrate_stable
properties.rationale: Significant hashrate changes could cause the difficulty bomb to manifest earlier or later than the intended 7.5 months.

properties.property: All clients MUST upgrade before fork block number to maintain consensus
properties.formal_spec: forall client: CLIENT. block.number == FORK_BLOCK_NUMBER => is_upgraded(client)
properties.rationale: Non-upgraded clients would compute different difficulty values, causing chain split.

properties.property: Multiple difficulty bomb delays MUST be applied cumulatively
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. total_offset(block) == sum(all_applicable_offsets(block))
properties.rationale: EIP-1234, EIP-4345, and similar EIPs each add their own offset which must be combined correctly.

properties.property: Difficulty calculation MUST be deterministic given same inputs
properties.formal_spec: forall b1, b2: BLOCK. same_inputs(b1, b2) => difficulty(b1) == difficulty(b2)
properties.rationale: Non-deterministic difficulty calculation would break consensus as nodes would disagree on valid blocks.

properties.property: Fake block number MUST never be negative (floor at 0)
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. fake_block_number(block) >= 0
properties.rationale: Negative fake block numbers would cause arithmetic errors in difficulty calculation.

properties.property: Contract execution context providing SSTORE operations MUST be validated
properties.formal_spec: forall sstore: SSTORE. valid_execution_context(sstore.caller)
properties.rationale: External contract execution provides the SSTORE key and value which must be handled by the gas metering system.

properties.property: Block headers received from peers MUST be fully validated before acceptance
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK, peer: PEER. received_from(block, peer) => must_validate(block.difficulty) && must_validate(block.rewards)
properties.rationale: Peer-provided blocks are untrusted and could contain malicious difficulty or reward values.

properties.property: Block difficulty from peer nodes MUST be validated against computed expected value
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK. from_peer(block) => requires_difficulty_validation(block)
properties.rationale: Peer nodes may send blocks with incorrect difficulty to attempt chain corruption.

properties.property: Block producers MUST meet the calculated difficulty target for block acceptance
properties.formal_spec: forall block: BLOCK, producer: MINER. produced_by(block, producer) => meets_difficulty_target(block)
properties.rationale: Miners/block producers are external entities whose blocks must meet consensus difficulty requirements.
